improvements.title: Per-frame capture provenance
improvements.problem: post/home-movie-2 attributed ONE shared gameplay state to a raw frame and its HUD-suppressed partner captured up to ~1 s apart while gameplay advanced; root flagged this in verifier-inbox.md at 10:02 UTC.
improvements.change: shoot() now delegates to shootOne(), which brackets EVERY screenshot with its own cheap pre-shot and post-shot observation (sampleProvenance: one small read-only evaluate). Each frame records its own window {startMs,endMs,durationMs}, its own image sha256/bytes/stats, its own raw-vs-percept role, and a crossings list. classifyCaptureProvenance() sets atStateClaimable=false whenever beat/objectiveId/markerLabel/workOrder/anchorId/activationSequence/milestones changed mid-capture; the frame is then reported as lying INSIDE a window, never pinned to a fabricated exact anchor instant. pairProvenance() records simultaneous:false plus the REAL pairOffsetMs and any state that crossed between the two partners.
preserved: original pixels written once, hashed, never re-encoded/cropped/filtered
intentional HUD hiding via the shipped evidence.mjs vox-hide-ui stylesheet, restored in a finally block
legacy per-frame atMs/beat/objectiveId/anchor keys retained (now the frame's OWN post-shot values) so v1 readers still parse
improvements.bootBlackFrame: classifyLuma() flags a blank/near-black frame as bootBlackFrameCandidate and sets visualAcceptance:false on EVERY frame without exception. A boot black frame is progression evidence only.

improvements.change: selectPlayerPose() prefers a full-precision journey-snapshot pose across six candidate paths and falls back to the rounded __autopilot.pos, ALWAYS retaining the rounded value as secondary and recording source/sourceClass/declaredPrecisionUnits/observedQuantumUnits/fullPrecisionAvailable/frame. selectWorkerPose() prefers the 1e-2 entities['actor:w7744'] record over the 1e-1 __auditWorker global. deriveFootFrames() emits capsuleCentre, cylinderBottom (centre-1.3) and sole (centre-1.8) with upAssumed flagged. CommonGround diagnostics are FEATURE-DETECTED from an allow-list of candidate hook names (plus an optional --cg-diag-hook / --cg-score-diag-hook operator override) and recorded as unavailable with the exact list of names probed when nothing answers.
notAssumed: no mutating route planner, preparation grant or progress setter is ever called (enforced by self-test D1)
improvements.metricSemantics: Every traversal figure carries PATH_METRIC_SEMANTICS: metricClass 'measurement-lower-bound', isRuntimeProof false, with the chording, quantisation, capsule-centre-vs-feet and 'walked distance is not credited progress' caveats inline.

improvements.title: Opt-in bounded stall FAIL predicate for ch13 on-foot walk/interact
improvements.predicate: FAIL when, for a continuous window >= windowMs (multiplied by holdMultiplier while the runtime reports its own non-null holdReason), NONE of the following changed: (a) story state — beat, objectiveId, markerLabel, workOrder, anchorId, signed-AV activationSequence, localActor milestones; (b) the CommonGround diagnostic physical-progress signature, WHEN that diagnostic is actually exposed; (c) player capsule-centre displacement accumulated to >= playerUnits; (d) worker pose displacement accumulated to >= actorUnits; (e) the ship pose accumulated to >= shipUnits while controlMode is 'flight'. The phase must be in --stall-fail-phases and no deliberate manual wait may be declared.
falseFailureGuards: deliberate manual wait: --manual-hold-ms makes the predicate inert for that many ms from start (and resets the window while active)
active flight: a ship that is genuinely moving in flight controlMode resets the window. Flight mode ALONE does not exempt — the parked-ship VF-DEEPLINK-1 shape must still FAIL
ongoing actor motion: W-7744 walking his own leg resets the window

intentional cue holds: a caption on screen or an explicit cue-hold window SUPPRESSES firing without resetting the clock, so a cue that never ends still fails, just later; every suppression is recorded in the FAIL
out-of-scope phases (cutscene, flight lane, etc.) are not judged at all
a runtime-declared holdReason widens the required window rather than disabling the predicate
onFire: capture the frozen moment (raw + percept when --percept)
fall through to the ORDINARY graceful finalization: trace, frames, complete summary.json, session.stop()
NO rescue, nudge, teleport, key press or progress grant of any kind
improvements.neverSuccess: summary.outcome is one of FAIL-STALL | CHECKPOINTED-INCONCLUSIVE | REACHED-STOP-PREDICATE | BUDGET-EXHAUSTED-INCONCLUSIVE, with outcomeIsAcceptance:false. No value in that vocabulary is a pass; a timeout, stall or checkpoint can never be read as success. Self-test D2 asserts the harness never sets isSuccess/visualAcceptance/outcomeIsAcceptance true.
improvements.rootControlIntact: pollControl still re-reads verifier-control.json every --control-ms (default 10000, <= 10 s) and a checkpoint still exits 0 with checkpointed:true after a complete summary.
limits: sample-rate/quantisation bound: motion under the pose quantum between samples is invisible and can read as stagnation
without the CommonGround diagnostic, internal route/cursor progress is unobservable; the FAIL then covers only what could be observed and says so in physicalProgressCaveat
a legitimately very slow approach moving under playerUnits per window would be a false FAIL — widen --stall-fail-ms rather than relaxing --stall-units
the phase label comes from the shipped autopilot routeAction / prompt presence, not from the chapter; a mislabelled phase can put the predicate out of scope and hide a real stall
it cannot distinguish 'wedged' from 'waiting for an input the probe was never asked to send'; manual lanes must declare --manual-hold-ms or leave the predicate off

honestLimits: Nothing here measures, verifies or accepts the current game source. The engineer was mid-edit throughout.

The Playwright wiring (shootOne, sampleProvenance, the second read-only evaluate, the stall observation assembly) has NOT been executed against a browser. Offline tests cover the pure modules and a static safety scan only.

Full-precision live player pose does not exist today; every path metric is a quantisation- and sample-rate-bound LOWER BOUND, measured on the capsule CENTRE, and is not runtime proof of credited progress.
The local planet up-axis is not exposed to any probe global. Foot-frame derivations assume +Y and are invalid on a non-top cube face; this is flagged in every record rather than silently used.

CommonGround phase/cursor/hold/foot-frame state remains UNOBSERVABLE until IR-1 lands. A stall FAIL taken without it is a measured stagnation of everything observable, not a proof that no internal counter moved.
The stall predicate's phase label is the probe's inference from the shipped autopilot routeAction and prompt presence, not a chapter-authored phase.
The harness makes NO chapter-acceptance, visual-taste, visible-content or audibility assertion. visualAcceptance is hard-false on every frame; SFX counts remain queue observations, not hearing.
No creative interpretation was made and no threshold or proof predicate was relaxed. cgContract.mjs and its signed-contract hash gate are unchanged.
This report claims no publication, no readiness and no gate.
